title: Defense to present Cale88's Lourdes Lebosada as witness
summary: Vice President Sara Duterte"s defense team will present Cale88"s Lourdes Lebosada as a witness to testify on matters about the company linked to second gentleman Manases Carpio.

blocks.text: Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense team will present Cale88’s Lourdes Lebosada as a witness to testify on matters about the company linked to second gentleman Manases Carpio.

Lebosada was previously identified by financial forensic analyst Alexander Cabrera as Carpio’s business partner in Cale88. Lebosada, who was also reportedly Duterte’s dentist, allegedly received paychecks amounting to P11.35 million.
In a letter addressed to the Senate impeachment court, the defense asked for the issuance of a subpoena to two witnesses.

“Dr. Lebosada will testify on matters relating to Cale88 Foods Corporation's organizational structure, government registrations, business operations, financial affairs, ownership, and other related matters, and identify documents relevant to and in support of her testimony,” the defense wrote in its request for a subpoena.
Lebosada is also asked to present documents such as Cale88’s registration documents, operational documents, financial and business documents, and more.
The defense also asked the Senate impeachment court for a subpoena for the Bureau of Customs’ Deputy Commissioner of Assessment And Operations Coordinating Group Agaton Teodoro O. Uvero.

“Atty. Uvero will testify on matters relating to Cale88 Foods Corporation's exportation records in the custody of the Bureau of Customs, identify documents relevant to his testimony, and such other relevant matters,” the defense wrote.
The defense also asked to subpoena Cale88’s Certificate of Registration as well as other documents pertaining to the company’s exportations.

Cale88 is the food company declared in Dutetre’s Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN) but has been flagged for allegedly anomalous business transactions after it received large remittances from China.
House prosecutors have questioned Cale88’s large income despite it at one point having no employees. — with reports from Sandra Aguinaldo/ VAL, GMA News
